description: Thinks step by step in a <think> block before answering math. d12 (286M params) pretrained at home on an RTX 3060, then chat fine-tuned with its identity plus 240K worked math problems (SFT step 1038). GSM8K 14.6%.
Knows it is WesleyGPT. d12 chat fine-tuned with its own identity mixed in (SFT step 934).
The first chat model: d12 fine-tuned on general conversations, multiple choice and math, with no identity (SFT step 934). It doesn't know its name.
The pretrained base model, before any chat training (step 2520). It is not a chatbot: it continues whatever text you send.
